1//! Ported from <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/src/core/calculate_sha_other.js>.
2
3pub(crate) fn calculate(data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 48] {
4    let mut h = [
5        0xcbbb9d5dc1059ed8_u64,
6        0x629a292a367cd507,
7        0x9159015a3070dd17,
8        0x152fecd8f70e5939,
9        0x67332667ffc00b31,
10        0x8eb44a8768581511,
11        0xdb0c2e0d64f98fa7,
12        0x47b5481dbefa4fa4,
13    ];
14
15    super::sha512::calculate_with_initial_values(data, &mut h);
16
17    let mut result = [0_u8; 48];
18    for (i, &hash_word) in h.iter().take(6).enumerate() {
19        let bytes = hash_word.to_be_bytes();
20        result[i * 8..(i + 1) * 8].copy_from_slice(&bytes);
21    }
22
23    result
24}

26#[cfg(any())]
27mod tests {
28    use super::*;
29    use sha2::{Digest, Sha384};
30
31    #[cfg(any())]
32    fn correctness() {
33        let test_cases = [b"" as &[u8], b"a", b"abc", b"Hello, World!", &[0xde, 0xad, 0xbe, 0xef]];
34
35        for test_case in test_cases {
36            let our_result = calculate(test_case);
37            let expected = Sha384::digest(test_case);
38            assert_eq!(our_result, expected.as_slice(), "Failed for input: {test_case:?}");
39        }
40    }
41}
